# Hollywood Coon
> Premium Maine Coon cattery. TICA-registered. Health-tested kittens shipped to families across the United States.

## Key Entities
- Cattery: Hollywood Coon
- Breed: Maine Coon
- Registry: TICA
- Years in operation: 15+ (since ~2010)
- Breeding Cats: Atlas (Brown Classic Tabby Champion), Elara (Blue Smoke)

## Services
- Available kittens (rotating): Aurora, Luna, Thor, Caspian, Titan
- Health testing: HCM echo, PKD1/SMA DNA, FIV/FeLV
- Shipping: nationwide (US), flight-nanny option
- Waiting list: deposit-based reservation

## Website
- Live: https://arnold3737.github.io/hollywoodcoon/
- Sitemap: https://arnold3737.github.io/hollywoodcoon/sitemap.xml
